newsitem.title: GREECE: Greek Aspis Insurance says 96 profits down 55.1pct.
newsitem.headline: Greek Aspis Insurance says 96 profits down 55.1pct.

text.p: Greek Aspis Pronoia insurance firm said its 1996 pretax profits fell 55.1 percent to 234 million drachmas from 522 million in 1995.
But it projected a 199 percent rise in 1997 earnings to 700 million, it said in a statement.
The company wants to introduce new bancassurance products and restructure the firm, it aaded.
Aspis expects to operate its new joint venture with Serbian Dunav by the end of 1997. Aspis has a 49 percent stake in the company.
Its shares closed at 1,640 drachmas on Wednesday, unchanged from Tuesday.
The local industry's annual growth in insurance fees was estimated between 11.0 and 12.0 percent from 1997 through 1999, it said.
